purpose: Practical rules learned from the approved book and iterative R17 draft; no automatic approval or guarantee.

lessons.rule: Set up a concrete problem, let PinPin form a plan, attempt it, show the surprising consequence and the family response. Insert approach/threshold/return beats when a location changes.

Earn warmth and laughter through actual action. Herculean determination, not exhausted faces or constant raised eyebrows. Quiet physical action can carry high discovery. Four days have 100/13/22/36 scenes in R17; long day1 allocation is visible for discussion, not automatically a defect.
Current story has six magical complications. Twelve refers to duck count; the old twelve-challenge plan is superseded.
Papa is adult, broad and round-faced. PomPom is the infant; PinPin is the active child. Keep separate bodies, plausible joints and gaze toward the object or partner.

Use complete mounted silhouette as scale authority: withers near standing Papa head. Show head ducking through door and floor occupancy when indoors. A few washed plain blueberries are a small treat, not a pile of unidentified wild berries.
One bucket during the opening errand through scene19. Papa introduces another at scene20; later catch-buckets are valid. Track empty/full states and handle grip.

Two round front windows and solid green front door. Doors behind/right in the kitchen view are interior rooms; the garden can be behind camera. Do not turn an interior door into an exterior shortcut. Preserve architecture from the specific camera reference.

Open U-shaped ends form a continuous floor channel from bath to garden. It is installed from scene34 through scene122 and dismantled at scene123 (R17 page167). Papa steps over, not through. Tight close-ups can legitimately occlude it.

Bear and blue utility tractor are new R17 designs, agent-reviewed and user-pending. Blue tractor is separate from the existing red logging tractor. That red tractor crane belongs immediately behind the cab, ahead of logs.

Give two separate inputs: successful continuous house panorama for projection/continuity, target book image for identity/style. Generate one 2:1 image, inspect in viewer, use registered perspective repairs only where needed, then deterministically export the cubemap. Do not generate six unrelated faces.
Localized full-bleed cover with title lettering on the image; separate text-free miniature. PDF includes three black-and-white coloring pages. Rebuild PDF only once story version is approved.

Keep exact native output, prompt, references and hashes. Separate selected candidates, agent review, user approval and published state. For recovered03l/03m the tool-output association is explicitly inferred/unverified; do not upgrade it. Scope repairs to the reported defect.

Discuss text, inspect small contact sheets, then generate referenced candidates in short cycles. Time planning/generation/review/export separately; 30 minutes is a measured improvement target, never a promise for a 171-image revision. Native assets and builds live on Mini SSD; Git stores recipes and content-addressed restore manifests.
